comment: M18 friendship scenes: friend_<npc>_<tier> plays the first time Bond reaches that tier (Acquaintance 11, Friend 41, Close 71, Unbreakable 86). Kelly and the Core Four have all four; side students Friend and Close. Unbreakable starts their personal arc (arc_<npc>) and gives their unique card.

steps.text: Acquaintance
Kelly catches you outside the gym, arms crossed.

steps.speaker: kelly
steps.text: You saw me freak out down there. If you tell anyone, I'll end you. Socially.

steps.speaker: kelly
steps.text: ...Thanks for not leaving, though.
Friend
Kelly runs a routine alone on the empty field and lets you watch.

steps.speaker: kelly
steps.text: Everyone thinks it's easy. It's not easy. It's just practice until nobody can see the practice.

steps.speaker: kelly
steps.text: Don't clap. ...Fine. You can clap.
Close
She shows you the lantern. She sleeps with it on now.

steps.speaker: kelly
steps.text: I used to be the scariest thing in this school. Now I know what's under it.

steps.speaker: kelly
steps.text: If I panic again, you're the one I want next to me. That's not a compliment. It's a fact.
Unbreakable
The squad is gone for the night. It's just Kelly, the bleachers, and the stars.

steps.speaker: kelly
steps.text: I'm done pretending I'm fine. I'm not fine. But I'm not alone, either.

steps.speaker: kelly
steps.text: Whatever's down there, we go together. Deal?
Acquaintance
Theo is counting the ceiling tiles in the library. He started over twice.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.text: The numbers don't add up. The building's bigger on the inside by three tiles. I measured.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.text: You're the first person who didn't laugh.
Friend
Theo shows you a notebook full of diagrams: the Upside-Down, mapped by feel.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.text: Force pushes, Motion carries. If you combine them right, nothing can stand still.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.text: I've never told anyone this much. It's... nice. Talking.
Close
Theo admits he hasn't slept properly since week one.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.text: I keep thinking that if I understand it, it can't hurt me. That's not how anything works.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.text: But you're here. That's a variable I can count on.
Unbreakable
Theo hands you the notebook. The last page has your name on it, circled.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.text: Constant. That's what you are. In every equation I write now.

steps.speaker: theo
steps.text: Keep it. I memorized it anyway.
Acquaintance
Mara is sketching on the steps. The drawing is of you, from behind, walking into the woods.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.text: I didn't mean to draw you. My hand just did.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.text: Do you want it? ...You don't have to.
Friend
Mara takes you to the art room after hours. Every canvas has a door in it.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.text: I don't plan them. They just appear. I think they're real somewhere.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.text: You're the only one I've shown.
Close
Mara patches up your scraped hands without being asked.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.text: I'm better at fixing people than talking to them.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.text: Stay still. ...There. Good as new. Almost.
Unbreakable
Mara paints a door on your bedroom wall. It's the only one she's ever painted shut.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.text: So nothing can come through. Not from there, not ever.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.text: I'll always fix you up. Promise.
Acquaintance
Dex ambushes you at the arcade with two tokens.

steps.speaker: dex
steps.text: High score's mine but I'll let you lose to me. Generously.

steps.speaker: dex
steps.text: ...You're actually good. Rude.
Friend
Dex shows you his secret: a catapult made of rulers and rubber bands.

steps.speaker: dex
steps.text: Every joke's a plan if you squint. This one launches erasers at Mr. B's window.

steps.speaker: dex
steps.text: Kidding. Mostly. Want a turn?
Close
For once Dex isn't joking. He's sitting very still on the curb.

steps.speaker: dex
steps.text: Everyone laughs at me, so nobody looks too hard. That's the point.

steps.speaker: dex
steps.text: You looked anyway. Don't make it weird. ...Thanks.
Unbreakable
Dex hands you an arcade token with a hole drilled through it, on a string.

steps.speaker: dex
steps.text: Lucky token. I've never lost with it. That's a lie. But it feels true.

steps.speaker: dex
steps.text: You're my player two. Forever. No take-backs.
Acquaintance
Priya corners you after debate practice.

steps.speaker: priya
steps.text: You argued with me in class and almost won. Almost.

steps.speaker: priya
steps.text: Come back when you want to lose properly.
Friend
Priya shows you the library shelf nobody checks out: town records, all signed by the same hand.

steps.speaker: priya
steps.text: Facts win arguments. These facts are terrifying.

steps.speaker: priya
steps.text: I'm glad you're on my side.
Close
Priya practices a speech to an empty hall. Her voice shakes, once.

steps.speaker: priya
steps.text: Everyone thinks I'm effortless. I rehearse everything. Even this.

steps.speaker: priya
steps.text: I didn't rehearse telling you that. Weird.
Unbreakable
Priya gives you her lucky pen, the one she's never lost a debate with.

steps.speaker: priya
steps.text: Closing argument: you're worth it. No rebuttal accepted.

steps.speaker: priya
steps.text: Motion carried.
Friend

steps.speaker: baxter
steps.text: Hmph. You fence well. For an amateur. Again, then.
Baxter salutes you with his practice foil.
Close
Baxter breaks his foil on a post and doesn't yell. That's new.

steps.speaker: baxter
steps.text: I lose my temper when I'm scared. I'm scared a lot lately. Don't tell anyone.
Friend
Diane opens her notebook to a fresh page and writes your name.

steps.speaker: diane
steps.text: You're a source now. Congratulations. It's mostly paperwork.
Close
Diane tears a page out and gives it to you.

steps.speaker: diane
steps.text: Officially I don't take sides. Unofficially: yours.
Friend
Jake shows you a dagger he forged. It's lopsided and proud.

steps.speaker: jake
steps.text: First one that didn't crack! The blacksmith grunted. That's basically a medal.
Close
Jake works the bellows with you until the forge glows.

steps.speaker: jake
steps.text: Every hobby I start, I quit. Not this one. Not this time.
Friend
Jon explains elemental theory with action figures.

steps.speaker: jon
steps.text: Heat beats Cold, obviously, but Cold beats Heat if you're patient! It's all in the lore!
Close
Jon gets quiet for the first time ever.

steps.speaker: jon
steps.text: Theo's smarter than me. I'm just louder. ...Is that okay?
Friend
Kris is napping on the bleachers. He opens one eye.

steps.speaker: kris
steps.text: I heard everything you said in class. All of it. I just don't move.
Close
Kris hands you a list of everything strange he's noticed this month. It's long.

steps.speaker: kris
steps.text: Don't make a thing of it.
Friend
Mel shoots hoops at dusk and sinks nine in a row.

steps.speaker: mel
steps.text: Everyone thinks I'm a kid. Good. They never guard me.
Close
Mel shows you his report card. All A's. He looks miserable.

steps.speaker: mel
steps.text: I'm good at everything they make me do. I just want to play ball.
Friend
Penny re-measures your lab results. Then again.

steps.speaker: penny
steps.text: Your error margin is acceptable. That's high praise.
Close
Penny makes a mistake on purpose to see what happens. Nothing happens.

steps.speaker: penny
steps.text: Huh. The world didn't end. ...Don't tell anyone I did that.
Friend
Phase carries three crates from the deli at once and doesn't notice.

steps.speaker: phase
steps.text: Was something happening? I was thinking about sandwiches.
Close
Phase stands between you and a falling shelf without thinking.

steps.speaker: phase
steps.text: Oh. Were you in danger? Cool. I mean, not cool. You're fine now.
Friend
Sam is asleep against a locker. He wakes up exactly when the bell rings.

steps.speaker: sam
steps.text: Five more minutes. ...Fine. Hi.
Close
Sam shows up at exactly the right moment, again.

steps.speaker: sam
steps.text: Lucky. Or unlucky. Depends on the day. Today's a good one.
